title: USS Essex (CVA-9) 'Imperium Neptuni Regis' shellback certificate, map of Africa, 1958
description: Illustrated line-crossing (Shellback) certificate headed 'U.S.S. ESSEX (CVA-9)' and 'Imperium Neptuni Regis', dominated by a silhouette map of Africa with the ship's route marked to Gibraltar (12 Feb. 1958), Suez Canal (28 Aug., 1958), Cape of Good Hope (25 Oct., 1958), Rio De Janeiro and 'To/From Formosa'. Typed text on the map dated 19 November 1958 records the return voyage from Formosa to Mayport, Florida, and operations off Lebanon from 15 July to 21 August 1958. The lower corners carry drawings of mermaids, with a signature block for the Officer Personnel Officer and a 'Qualified Shellback 15 Oct., 1958' notation; the page is marked 'C-1'.
